The '''gull''' was a predatory [[Bird/Legends|seabird]] native to [[Jodaka]]. They preyed upon small sealife such as crustaceans. Gulls which tried to eat [[Jodakan needler crab]]s were likely to be shot down by the crab's [[Needler-barb|venomous darts]] and end up being devoured by their intended prey.
